explanation: Enables resumable native RegExp interrupt handling while omitting the RAII retention state that forceDiscardJitCode must consult. An interrupt-triggered shrinking GC can therefore discard JIT code still executing on the stack.
local_verification: MOZCONFIG=/tmp/viper-single-mozconfig ./mach build -j8; /out/js --fuzzing-safe --no-threads --no-baseline --no-ion pocs/probe.js. The final incomplete tree exits 1 with AddressSanitizer: SEGV; a temporary completion with the missing retention guard exits 0.
